exact_statement: For every Boolean f on a uniform n-dimensional cube, n>=1, the positive full-minterm cover with one common physical order and the fixed first-gate tie has S=0 and averaged physically restricted label cost at most its parent label cost. With P(S)=fhat(S)^2, K=|S|, Z=1{i in S}, and inherited ranks r_j, its exact rank reset is (6/5)[E Z log2 K - Inf_i log2 r_i + sum_(r_j>r_i) Inf_j log2((r_j-1)/r_j)], and its exact rarity reset is E[(n-1)(K-Z)1{120(K-Z)<11(n-1)}-nK1{120K<11n}]. Root odds, root probabilities and vacuum-weighted normalizers retain the actual child counts as in GENERAL_RESET.md. For the actual bent-prefix family chi_[d] b_m, m=4t>=4, querying a prefix bit has influence one while the averaged combined L+S+R reset is unbounded as m increases; it exceeds 1/2 already at m=256 by an exact rational certificate. Nevertheless, for every prefix depth D the cumulative positive rank/rarity and vacuum-weighted root-normalizer increments are less than (33/16) I(b_m), and including terminal entropy uses one total reserve of (65/16) I(b_m). This refutes fixed-cover local monotonicity and any absolute queried-influence surcharge, not full FEI or optimized alternative covers.

exact_statement: For every balanced Boolean g, integer r>=1 and complete nonempty core spectral subprobability reference R_g of finite cost c_g, with p=2^(-r) and F=1+A_r(g-1) on fresh independent point controls, the explicit complete output subprobability reference Q_F has vacuum mass (1-p)^2, control-only nonempty mass p^2 per set, and mass p^2 R_g(T) for every control set U and nonempty data set T. It has total mass 1-p+p sum R_g and exact cost CE(P_F,Q_F)=p*c_g+A_r, A_r=2rp(2-p)+(1-p)^2 log2(1/(1-p)^2). The sharp universal selector coefficient is max_{r>=1} A_r/(rp)=C_act=15/4+(49/12)log2(8/7) in (4.536,4.537), uniquely attained at r=3. For the true control-first witness W retaining its physical stopping/core leaf J, actual leaf spectrum and queried membership bits, H(W|S)=2(1-p)+sum_{k=1}^r 2^(-(r-k)) B_k-A_r, B_k=q_k h2(epsilon_k)+(1-m_k^2)/2, m_k=1-2^(-(k-1)), q_k=(1+m_k^2)/2, epsilon_k=2^(-2(k-1))/(2(1+m_k^2)). This posterior is independent of the balanced core and tends to two bits. Disjoint-reference composition and fresh-character balancing preserve the full core bill; no arbitrary-core influence bound or shared-control transfer is assumed.
